commitments.detail: Review patient's condition and treatment plan.
Ensure appropriate use of non-formulary medication.
Inform them of the medication order for follow-up care.
Regular monitoring of the patient's response to Lunacavir will be conducted by the Infectious Disease Department.
The Utilization Review Team will be notified of the emergency use of Lunacavir and will conduct a review upon completion of the treatment.
The Outpatient Pharmacy will be informed of the prescription details and will prepare for follow-up care post-discharge.
